subject: MSA + Order Form: audit scope alignment and pen-test clause proposal
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form kickoff — audit scope & pen-test clause

Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching a proposed pen-test clause and a simple evidence cadence matrix to slot into the MSA/Order Form. High level asks:

- We want to preserve bounded inspection language (30-day notice + limited scope) while allowing a single annual penetration test and SOC 2 evidence requests.
- Proposed cadence: SOC 2 report (annual), rolling evidence requests (quarterly sampling by category), pen-test window (once per 12 months; 72-hour notice preferred but we can accept a 2-week scheduling window for staging).

Please find the attachments: redwood_pen_test_clause_v2.docx (editable clause with a short rationale) and evidence_cadence_matrix.xlsx.

A few specific questions for clarity before legal redlines:
1) Do you need explicit language about live attack windows vs. whitebox vs. staging-only pen tests?
2) Is a third-party SOC 2 Type II sufficient for your procurement team, or do you require any additional certs/evidence?
3) Are there regional carve-outs we should be aware of for EU data centers?

If helpful we can set a 30-minute working session with procurement + security + our legal (Priyom + Laura) tomorrow afternoon. Proposed times: 2:00pm or 4:00pm PT.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_clause_v2.docx (draft clause), evidence_cadence_matrix.xlsx (proposed sampling buckets)

From: Emma Clarke <emma@helixhealth.com>

Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form kickoff — audit scope & pen-test clause

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the clear starting point. Quick responses inline:

1) We prefer staging-only pen tests where possible; for critical vulnerabilities we may request a live verification step but that requires explicit pre-approval.
2) SOC 2 Type II is acceptable baseline for procurement, but they will likely want a short attestation that the report covers the services referenced in the order form.
3) No EU carve-outs for this contract (we’re on Helix global platform), but we will flag any KMS/HSM restrictions if needed.

I’ve attached our security questionnaire (helix_security_questionnaire_Fillable.pdf) that procurement asks every vendor to complete — can your team fill the service-specific sections and return by EOD Friday?

Procurement — tagging you for timing. Rafael — 2:00pm PT tomorrow works on our side if you can get Priyom and Laura on the call.

Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: audit scope alignment and pen-test clause proposal

Emma — appreciate the quick answers and the questionnaire. I pasted a short redline proposal below that Priyom and Laura flagged as the cleanest compromise for procurement and security. Can Priyom confirm legal ok and Laura confirm ops feasibility?

---- Suggested clause (summary) ----
1) Penetration testing: "Customer may request no more than one (1) penetration test per twelve (12) month period. Tests shall be conducted against staging environments unless explicitly agreed in writing. Customer must provide at least fourteen (14) days' advance notice; Redwood will provide a mutually agreeable 72-hour maintenance window for verification of remediation at Customer's request. Redwood will not permit active exploitation of customer data in live production without prior written consent."

2) Audit & evidence cadence: "Customer may request SOC 2 Type II report once per year and up to four (4) evidence requests per rolling 12-month period for predefined categories (access controls, encryption, logging & monitoring, change controls). Evidence requests will be scoped to sampled artifacts and operational screenshots; sensitive logs may be redacted. Redwood will respond to reasonable evidence requests within five (5) business days for SOC 2 attestation items and up to ten (10) business days for operational artifact requests."

3) Scoped inspection rights: "Inspection or forensic access will be limited to bounded sampling; any privileged or forensics-level access requires a signed inspection plan and a mutually agreed remediation timeline. Parties agree to coordinate on scheduling to minimize customer or tenant impact."

---- end clause ----

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HLX-2026-77) and the evidence matrix in Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_evidence_matrix).

Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form: audit scope alignment and pen-test clause proposal

Quick internal update — reviewed Rafael's suggested language and propose the following edits before sending an updated clause to Helix:

- Tighten the notice language: change "at least fourteen (14) days' advance notice" to "no less than ten (10) business days' advance notice" to keep scheduling predictable for infra.
- Replace "four (4) evidence requests" with "up to three (3) operational evidence requests" to limit operational churn; keep SOC 2 annual.
- Add explicit redaction/custodial clause: we will provide artifacts with PII redacted and will not provide raw transaction logs without a subpoena or written consent.
- Add a short SLA response window for evidence delivery: 5 business days for attestation items, 10 business days for operational artifacts (matches Rafael's draft).

Next steps: I will fold these edits into redwood_pen_test_clause_v3.docx and share a clean copy by EOD. Rafael — if Helix confirms staging-only preference and sends the completed questionnaire by Friday EOD, we can lock the clause and push to procurement next week.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
priopm@redwood.com

(Internal note: Laura — please confirm that a 10-business-day artifact window is operationally achievable for the sample sizes in the evidence matrix.)
